should_mount.label: Mount after teleporting
should_mount.tooltip: The mount to use after teleporting.

path_to_destination.label: Path to event after teleporting
path_to_destination.tooltip: Use vnavmesh to head to the next event after teleporting via the OCH panel.

return_after_fate.label: Return to base after FATE
return_after_fate.tooltip: Use Occult Return upon finishing a FATE to return to base camp.

return_after_critical_encounter.label: Return to base after Critical Encounter
return_after_critical_encounter.tooltip: Use Occult Return upon finishing a Critical Encounter to return to base camp.

approach_aetheryte.label: Approach aetheryte after returning
approach_aetheryte.tooltip:
Walk to the aetheryte after returning to base camp.
* Only works when returning via the plugin after a FATE or Critical Encounter.

return_position.title: Return position
return_position.arrive_distance_tooltip:
Stop walking once within this distance of the custom return position.
Original behaviour stops within 3.8 yalms of the aetheryte.
return_position.help: After casting Return, BOCCHI walks to this position (requires vnavmesh and "Approach aetheryte after returning"). Keep it near the aetheryte (within 15 yalms) so automation can teleport via the aethernet from there.
